notes: Spark-X2.6-4B_int8-kv2048.litertlm of litert-community/Spark-X2.6-4B: the INT8 file with its KV cache cut to 2,048 tokens = the 4B file for a CPU at reasoning_effort low (its 2,048 tokens must hold prompt, thought and answer, so it is not for the default effort's 3,584-token budget). XHToken/Spark-X2.6-4B (Apache-2.0) converted to LiteRT-LM; the bundle carries templates/spark26_think.jinja (the vendor template's plain-chat part, thinking on by default, reasoning_effort high or low through extra_context), a `thought` channel and the repo's tokenizer.json byte for byte. Uploaded 2026-11-01 (Hub main f8da7265 at the read). Measured 2026-11-01 in the run r6; its build check: max_num_tokens 2048, llm_model_type generic_model, tokenizer bytes equal to the repo's.
quantization: the weights of Spark-X2.6-4B_int8.litertlm unchanged (dynamic INT8, per-channel INT8 weights on every linear and the embedding, FP32 activations declared; every weight buffer byte-checked) and its exported graph with the KV cache of every signature cut from 4,096 to 2,048 tokens without a re-export (LiteRT-LM 0.19.0 unpack, the KV-cache variant tool, LlmMetadata max_num_tokens 2,048, packed with the 0.19.0 CLI), prefer_activation_type fp32, 6 prefill signatures, KV cache 2,048
